proposed statement: The client's receptionists are burning out due to high phone volume and double bookings.
key statement: Fewer missed calls, no double bookings and fewer no-shows; the phones are the top priority, because the receptionists are burning out.

proposed statement: The client wants to move from paper diaries to a single digital diary that integrates phone bookings.
key statement: Receptionists see their clinic's day, move bookings, and enter phone bookings in the same system, because some older clients will never book online.

proposed statement: The client has a high volume of appointments that doubles during vaccination seasons due to annual events.

proposed statement: The client has a system where owners must manually print vaccination lists and call clients to send reminders, which is time-consuming.
key statement: Vaccination-due reminders go out automatically, from the due dates VetDesk holds, with a link to book. This replaces the monthly printed list and phone calls.
